{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness(DSH) plugin for Milvus","id":"gh:1338234244","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-milvus","slug":"zilliztech/dsh-milvus","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","milvus"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness(DSH) plugin for Milvus"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Milvus for DSH"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Milvus for DSH lets a DSH Desktop or Web agent inspect and search a Milvus deployment
from chat. It "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"supports Local Milvus and Zilliz Cloud, exact entity lookup,
scalar queries, BM25 full-text search, "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"and dense+BM25 hybrid retrieval.
Natural-language dense search uses a DSH-managed embedding provider"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"; BM25 runs
entirely from the collection's Milvus Function schema."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Every Milvus operation exposed by this plugin is read-only. The plugin does not
create collections, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"insert data, change indexes, or delete anything."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- DSH Desktop or Web `0.2.0-rc.2` or later, before `1.0.0`
- Node.js 22.19 or later
- A Milvus HTTP("},{"id":"p6s2","text":"S) endpoint reachable from the DSH host
- Optional: an API key from one of the supported embedding p"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"roviders for dense
and hybrid search"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter
`@zilliz/dsh-milvus`, install it, and restart t"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Desktop, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter
`@zilliz/dsh-milvus`, install it, and restart the app."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"For DSH Web, install the package into the Web profile:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"If `dsh` is not installed globally:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"After installing or updating the plugin, restart DSH Desktop or Web. Refresh
the browser page when u"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"talling or updating the plugin, restart DSH Desktop or Web. Refresh
the browser page when using Web."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Set up the plugin"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Open **Plugins**, then select **@zilliz/dsh-milvus**. Its configuration appears
on the plugin detail"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"s page. The setup follows the same order as using Milvus:
connect a deployment, choose a collection,"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" then enable only the search
capabilities you need."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Connect Milvus"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Choose **Local Milvus Standalone** or **Zilliz Cloud**, then enter the endpoint
and optional databas"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e. Local Milvus normally uses
`http://127.0.0.1:19530` and database `default`. Zilliz Cloud requires"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" its HTTPS
endpoint and token. For an authenticated local deployment, select **Add
optional authenti"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"cation** and enter its token."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"After saving, use **Test connection**. The card collapses the form into a
connection summary so the "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"deployment details no longer compete with collection
setup."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The endpoint is resolved from the machine running DSH. When Milvus runs in
another container or on a"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"nother host, use an address reachable from the DSH
host—not a loopback address inside the Milvus con"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"host, use an address reachable from the DSH
host—not a loopback address inside the Milvus container."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The active connection is bound when a new chat starts. Changing it affects new
chats; it does not si"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"lently switch an existing chat to a different deployment."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Choose a collection"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The Collection selector is populated from the connected Milvus database. Pick
one collection and DSH"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" inspects its fields, indexes, and Functions on the Host.
You do not type collection or schema field"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" names in the normal setup path."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The card then reports four capabilities:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Scalar query** is ready after a successful schema inspection.
- **BM25 search** is ready when th"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"e collection has one valid Milvus BM25
Function route. It does not need an external API key.
- **Sem"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"antic search** is ready after its embedding provider and discovered
`FloatVector` field are mapped.
"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"- **Hybrid search** becomes ready automatically when both BM25 and semantic
search are ready."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Enable semantic search when needed"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"This step is required only for natural-language dense and hybrid search. BM25
text search does not u"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"se an external embedding provider."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"1. Select **Enable** on the Semantic search capability.
2. Choose a provider and model that match th"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"e vectors already stored in the
collection.
3. Enter the provider API key.
4. Choose one `FloatVecto"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"r` field discovered from the selected collection.
5. Select **Enable semantic search**."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Collection requirements for search"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The plugin inspects each collection before searching it and reports whether
dense, BM25, and hybrid "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"retrieval are ready."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Dense search requires a configured binding to a dimensional `FloatVector`
field. BM25 search require"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"s all of these collection facts:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- one analyzer-enabled `VarChar` or `TEXT` input field;
- a Milvus BM25 Function mapping that text f"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ield to a `SparseFloatVector`
output field; and
- a BM25 index on that sparse field."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"When exactly one valid BM25 route exists, the plugin selects it automatically.
If a collection has s"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"everal BM25 text fields, the user must identify the one
to search in the request or save an exact co"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"llection policy; the agent does not
guess. A plain `SparseFloatVector` field without a BM25 Function"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" is not enough
because the plugin cannot infer which external sparse encoder created it."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Hybrid search is ready only when one dense binding and one BM25 route are both
ready. It never silen"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"tly falls back to one route if the other route is missing
or fails."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## What happens without an embedding key"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Collection listing, description, exact get, scalar query, and schema-compatible
BM25 search continue"},{"id":"p36s2","text":" to work. Dense and hybrid search are blocked, with a
specific configuration result:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- no collection binding: `retrieval_binding_absent`;
- binding refers to a missing provider profile:"},{"id":"p37s2","text":" `embedding_profile_absent`;
- API key is missing or unavailable: `embedding_credential_unavailable`"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"`embedding_profile_absent`;
- API key is missing or unavailable: `embedding_credential_unavailable`."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"The plugin does not fall back to the chat model, another provider, a guessed
vector, or a scalar que"},{"id":"p38s2","text":" plugin does not fall back to the chat model, another provider, a guessed
vector, or a scalar query."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Privacy and safety"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- Dense-search query text is sent from the DSH host to the embedding provider
selected in the bindin"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"g.
- The generated vector remains in host memory and is sent only to Milvus.
- Milvus tokens and pro"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"vider keys stay behind the DSH Credentials boundary.
- Output fields must exist in the inspected sch"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"ema and must be scalar.
- Filters may reference only scalar fields discovered from that collection.
"},{"id":"p40s5","text":"- Exact route fields prevent a saved BM25 plan from silently switching routes.
A saved schema finger"},{"id":"p40s6","text":"print, when present, additionally blocks the plan after
any retrieval-schema change until it is revi"},{"id":"p40s7","text":"ewed.
- The plugin exposes no mutation, schema, index, database, user, role, or
administrative opera"},{"id":"p40s8","text":"tion.
- External sparse encoders, model/cross-encoder rerank, ingestion, custom
embedding endpoints,"},{"id":"p40s9","text":" and manual vector input are not currently supported."}],"truncated":true}
